title: macOS SIGSEGV in AppleMetalOpenGLRenderer when resizing window too large
description: JVM fatal error: SIGSEGV in native AppleMetalOpenGLRenderer (GLRResourceList::addResource) when aggressively resizing the desktop window. Repro: LWJGL Ixdar, drag window edge to very large size. Java 21, macOS aarch64.
definition-of-done: 1. Repro and hs_err correlation documented. 2. Root cause narrowed to driver vs our resize path. 3. Mitigation implemented or documented workaround. 4. Manual stress test on macOS arm64 passes.
testing-plan: 1. Resize stress (slow and fast). 2. Fullscreen and multi-monitor if available.
